name: Browder's Birds Pastured Poultry
description: Browder's Birds Pastured Poultry is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 4050 Soundview Avenue, NY. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
